title: India's National Quantum Mission allocates ₹6,000 crore for quantum computing research
snippet: The Indian government has approved a massive funding boost for the National Quantum Mission, targeting breakthroughs in quantum computing, quantum communication, and quantum sensing by 2031.

title: IIT Madras demonstrates 20-qubit quantum processor prototype
snippet: Researchers at IIT Madras have unveiled a 20-qubit superconducting quantum processor, marking a significant milestone for India's quantum computing ambitions.

title: QNu Labs Bengaluru deploys quantum key distribution network for Indian banking sector
snippet: Bengaluru-based QNu Labs has rolled out a quantum cryptography solution for secure banking communications, making India one of the first countries to deploy QKD in the financial sector.

title: DRDO and ISRO collaborate on satellite-based quantum communication
snippet: DRDO and ISRO have announced a joint project to develop satellite-based quantum communication links, aiming to build an unhackable communication network for defence applications.

title: IISc Bangalore team achieves quantum error correction breakthrough
snippet: Scientists at the Indian Institute of Science have demonstrated a novel quantum error correction code that could make quantum computers more reliable and practical for real-world use.

title: Google achieves 1,000-qubit milestone with new Willow quantum chip
snippet: Google has announced its Willow quantum processor has surpassed the 1,000-qubit barrier, a major step toward practical quantum computing for drug discovery and materials science.

title: IBM unveils Quantum System Three with modular architecture
snippet: IBM has launched its next-generation Quantum System Three, featuring a modular design that allows multiple quantum processors to be linked for larger computations.

title: EU invests €2 billion in quantum technology for cybersecurity and sensing
snippet: The European Union has committed €2 billion to quantum technology research, focusing on quantum cryptography for cybersecurity and quantum sensing for medical diagnostics.

title: Chinese researchers demonstrate quantum internet link spanning 4,600 km
snippet: A team of Chinese scientists has established a quantum communication link over 4,600 kilometres using satellite relays, setting a new distance record for quantum key distribution.

title: Microsoft announces topological qubit breakthrough for fault-tolerant quantum computing
snippet: Microsoft has demonstrated a working topological qubit, which the company says could dramatically reduce error rates and pave the way for fault-tolerant quantum computing.

title: Quantum sensing technology detects underground structures with unprecedented precision
snippet: A UK startup has used quantum sensing based on cold-atom interferometry to map underground infrastructure, demonstrating quantum technology's practical benefits beyond computing.

title: Japan and Australia sign quantum technology cooperation agreement
snippet: Japan and Australia have signed a bilateral agreement to jointly develop quantum computing and quantum communication technologies as part of their broader tech alliance.
